The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. sar.narrative: Customer C09800, holder of card C09800-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-21 and 2016-12-21, 4 transaction(s) totalling $999.86 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3564216 and the transaction that triggered review being 3564258 for $249.97. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 299.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.3.0 | mobile safari 11.0 | 1334x750', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Found' for this account, reached through an transparent proxy. The activity matches no documented typology in the issuer's manual and is described in the accompanying case record. Closed investigation CC-2464 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $999.86.
